elements_selected.content: Extend demo-vault with content that exercises Merkle hashing, section grounding, and drift detection. Add or update: 1) demo-vault/decisions/Redis vs Memcached.md — add sections with headings (## Benchmark Results, ## Analysis), a metrics table with ^benchmark-results block-id tag, and an SPL block using (meta redis-fast-enough (source "^benchmark-results")), 2) demo-vault/architecture/Performance.md — add a paragraph tagged ^perf-numbers with performance requirements, 3) demo-vault/decisions/Deployment Decision.md — add cross-file SPL grounding: (meta perf-acceptable (source "[[Performance^perf-numbers]]")), 4) demo-vault/theories/caching.spl — standalone SPL file with facts grounded via Merkle hash (use placeholder hash from a prior zetl blocks run, or a realistic example). Files must have multiple ^block-id tags, headings at multiple levels, and SPL blocks both with and without explicit source metadata.
